posts.text: I've been tracking every death, every contract, every press release. This is what the data shows. Read my full Substack post here: austinkocher.substack.com/p/…

No independent investigation has been conducted into these deaths. ICE's releases read less like official government communications and more like a peeved Redditor trying to win an argument nobody asked them to join.
He's also the 43rd person to die in ICE custody since Trump took office. Instead of investigations, we get press releases now featuring bold text to emphasize "immediately" and criminal charges.

Adelanto is a private, for-profit facility run by GEO Group. Ramos-Solano is the 4th person to die there this year. In any prior administration, that number alone would have triggered a crisis response.

Jose Guadalupe Ramos-Solano died in ICE custody on March 25 at Adelanto, CA. He is the 14th person to die in ICE detention in 2026. That's one death every 6 days holding with what I can only call morbid precision.
